resources.string: Anchor a whole production lot on-chain with one Merkle root and print a two-layer label for every unit.
Between 1 and %1$d units. One transaction covers the whole batch.

Each unit gets a one-time key pair. Only the Merkle root of all public keys goes on-chain; the open QR identifies the unit, and the hidden QR under the scratch-off holds its private key for the buyer.
%1$d units are now anchored on the blockchain as batch #%2$s.
The manifest was not pinned to IPFS; its hash is still on-chain.
Unit keys are on this phone
The hidden codes of %1$d units exist only here and will not be shown again. Export the labels PDF and print it before discarding the keys.
Unit keys discarded. Neither this app nor the server can recreate the hidden codes.
